header.title: Tutorial & Phase Manager
header.description: Manage training phases, video tutorials (YouTube clips or MP4), and post-tutorial quiz popups.

stage.testSummary: Holds a scheduled test (manage it in Test Management)
stage.toggleQuizEnable: Enable quiz popups for the whole phase
stage.toggleQuizDisable: Disable quiz popups for the whole phase
stage.confirmDelete: Delete this stage and all its tutorials?
stage.testPhaseNote: This is a test phase — manage its test, schedule and questions in Test Management.

tutorial.toggleQuizEnable: Enable quiz popup for this tutorial
tutorial.toggleQuizDisable: Disable quiz popup for this tutorial

addPhaseModal.title: Add New Video Phase
addPhaseModal.note: This creates a video phase. Scheduled tests are managed in Test Management.

quiz.intro: Users see these 3–5 questions in a popup after finishing the tutorial. Options C and D are optional.

bulk.intro: Upload one .xlsx sheet listing all your videos. A row whose Phase + Title matches an existing tutorial UPDATES it; a new title is ADDED at the end of that phase. Nothing is ever deleted by an upload.
bulk.schemaTitle: Fixed sheet format — header row 1 must use these exact columns

schema.phase: Phase number exactly as shown on this page (e.g. 1 or 3). Must be a video phase, not a test phase.
schema.title: Tutorial title. Also the match key — a row with an existing title in that phase updates it.
schema.description: Short description shown under the title. Optional.
schema.module: Label like "Module 1.2". Auto-numbered when left empty.
schema.link: A YouTube link (watch / youtu.be / shorts / embed) OR a direct http(s) video file URL (.mp4/.webm). Detected automatically.
schema.start: Clip start — YouTube links only. Seconds or m:ss (e.g. 90 or 1:30). Empty = from the beginning.
schema.end: Clip end — must be after Start Time. Leave both empty to play the full video.
schema.duration: Minutes badge shown on the tutorial card. Whole number; default 5.
schema.quiz: yes / no — whether the post-tutorial quiz popup shows. Default yes.

bulk.note: Rows with problems are skipped and reported below — the valid rows still go through. Quiz questions themselves are managed per tutorial with the ? button after upload.
bulk.empty: The sheet has no data rows.
bulk.parseError: Could not read that file — is it a valid .xlsx sheet?
bulk.failed: Upload failed — check your connection and try again.
